latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best Video Letter Maker — quickly create and send personal video letters with text, photos, audio, and background music.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, JPG, and PNG files up to 200MB.
- Fast, automatic AI-powered video letter generation; most exports ready in 1–2 minutes.
- No video editing skills required; simply describe your desired outcome for personalized results.
- Cloud-based workflow with session management, credits system, and multiple export formats (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, etc.).
- Built-in error handling for common issues like token expiry, file size limits, and credits.
